headline: "From Real Estate to Stocks and Funds: Money Move; Regulations to Be Eased to Activate Finance"
summary: The Financial Supervisory Service governor and ruling party officials said at a national finance forum they would ease regulations. The aim is to diversify assets concentrated in real estate into stocks and funds.
why: The Financial Supervisory Service regulates South Korea's banks, securities firms and capital markets, so its rule changes shape investment flows.
